"""One diagnostic VM observation; never standard-deadline qualification."""
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time
E=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W=E.parent/'rog5-review-correctness-20260912-r1'
P=E/'vm-r1/result.json'
def digest(path):
    with pathlib.Path(path).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def write(path,value):
    with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
def main():
    if sys.argv[1:]:raise SystemExit('no arguments accepted')
    if subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=W):raise SystemExit('source not frozen')
    if subprocess.check_output(['podman','ps','-q']).strip():raise SystemExit('another container active')
    if json.loads((E/'active-result.json').read_text())['exit_status']!=0:raise SystemExit('active tier must pass')
    prior=json.loads(P.read_text())
    if prior['status']!='PASS':raise SystemExit('unexpected predecessor')
    # Prove the production sources and immutable inputs are the same as the
    # preceding passing close-only attempt. New work is the low-caret flow.
    # Retain the same diagnostic420s envelope; standard300s qualification excluded.
    verified={}
    for path,row in prior['inputs'].items():
        got=digest(path)
        if got!=row['sha256']:raise SystemExit('changed prior input: '+path)
        verified[path]=got
    args=prior['command'][2:]
    args[args.index('--output')+1]=str(E/'bottom-caret-r1')
    args.remove('--close-only')
    args+=['--automatic-caret','--bottom-caret']
    new_probe=E/'build-r1/settings-sync-diagnostic.so'
    if digest(new_probe)!='65535e5520368158cfcaf51b2a2c95fe012ed113aaea288a46c79e94df093b71':raise SystemExit('new probe changed')
    args[args.index('--settings-sync-diagnostic')+1]=str(new_probe)
    if '--close-only' in args or '--bottom-caret' not in args or '--automatic-caret' not in args or '--settings-sync-diagnostic' not in args:raise SystemExit('wrong scope')
    source=W/'scripts/host/test-qemu-logind.py'
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('production_logind',source)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    original=module.container
    changes=[]
    def diagnostic_container(command,name,log,deadline,steps,**kw):
        if log.name=='serial.log':
            if deadline!=300 or 'qemu-system-aarch64' not in command or changes:
                raise RuntimeError('unexpected diagnostic dispatch')
            changes.append({'container':name,'standard_seconds':300,'diagnostic_seconds':420,
                            'existing_conditional_cleanup_grace_seconds':module.APPS_CLEANUP_GRACE})
            deadline=420
            write(E/'bottom-caret-dispatch.json',changes[0])
        return original(command,name,log,deadline,steps,**kw)
    module.container=diagnostic_container
    record={'status':'RUNNING','authority':'none','scope':'diagnostic observation only; standard 300-second qualification excluded',
            'standard_qualification':'NOT RUN; prior FAIL retained','physical_status':'NOT RUN',
            'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=W,text=True).strip(),
            'source_tree':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],cwd=W,text=True).strip(),
            'wrapper_sha256':digest(__file__),'runner_sha256':digest(source),'verified_prior_inputs':verified,
            'command':[sys.executable,str(E/'run-bottom-caret.py')],'production_arguments':args}
    write(E/'bottom-caret-started.json',record)
    start=time.monotonic();sys.argv=[str(source),*args]
    code=module.main()
    raw=json.loads((E/'bottom-caret-r1/result.json').read_text())
    record.update(status='DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETED' if code==0 else 'DIAGNOSTIC_FAILED',
                  internal_check_status=raw['status'],exit_status=code,duration_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                  deadline_changes=changes,raw_result_sha256=digest(E/'bottom-caret-r1/result.json'))
    write(E/'bottom-caret-diagnostic-result.json',record)
    print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('status','internal_check_status','standard_qualification','duration_seconds')}))
    return code
if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
